mapper.select: select s.stage_id, s.competition_id, s.stage_name, s.stage_type, s.order_no, s.paper_id, p.paper_name from competition_stage s left join paper p on s.paper_id = p.paper_id where s.competition_id = #{competitionId} order by s.order_no
mapper.insert: insert into competition_stage (competition_id, stage_name, stage_type, order_no, paper_id) values (#{competitionId}, #{stageName}, #{stageType}, #{orderNo}, #{paperId})
